investment climate, investment environment (the economic and political conditions in a country that affect whether individuals and businesses are willing to invest capital)

High energy costs and bureaucratic hurdles are currently weighing on the German investment climate.

investment backlog, capital expenditure gap (a situation where a company or industry fails to reinvest sufficiently to maintain or modernize its productive assets, often characterized by net investments falling below depreciation levels)
Ein chronischer Investitionsstau kann die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit eines Unternehmens langfristig untergraben.
A chronic investment backlog can undermine a company's competitiveness in the long run.
Analysten warnten vor einem Investitionsstau bei dem Automobilzulieferer, da die Ausgaben für Forschung und Entwicklung stagnierten.
Analysts warned of an investment backlog at the automotive supplier as spending on research and development stagnated.

infrastructure backlog, public underinvestment (the accumulation of deferred maintenance and necessary upgrades in public assets such as transport, education, and digital networks, often resulting from fiscal constraints or budgetary priorities)

The new government has set itself the goal of resolving the massive investment backlog in the rail infrastructure.
In vielen Kommunen führt ein Investitionsstau dazu, dass öffentliche Gebäude wie Schulen und Schwimmbäder baufällig werden.

investment push, capex offensive (a strategic and massive increase in capital expenditure by a company or industry to gain market share, enter new markets, or achieve technological leadership)

With a multi-billion dollar investment push, the semiconductor manufacturer aims to reduce its dependence on external suppliers.

The announced investment push may weigh on cash flow in the short term, but it secures future growth.
public investment drive, stimulus program (a large-scale government initiative to stimulate economic growth and modernize public infrastructure through increased spending)
Die Europäische Union hat eine Investitionsoffensive für den Ausbau grüner Energien gestartet.
The European Union has launched an investment drive for the expansion of green energies.
Kritiker fordern eine staatliche Investitionsoffensive, um den drohenden wirtschaftlichen Abschwung abzufedern.
Critics are calling for a government investment drive to cushion the impending economic downturn.
investment fund, mutual fund (a supply of capital belonging to numerous investors used to collectively purchase securities while each investor retains ownership and control of his own shares)
Ein Investmentfonds bietet durch die Streuung des Kapitals auf verschiedene Wertpapiere einen gewissen Schutz vor Totalverlust.
By spreading capital across different securities, an investment fund offers a certain degree of protection against total loss.

s: investment company, investment trust (a corporate structure, usually an Aktiengesellschaft, that manages collective investments in assets)
